INSERT INTO Builds (
                finished, timestamp, jobset_id, job, nixname, drvPath, storeDir, system,
                maxsilent, timeout, ischannel, iscurrent, priority, globalpriority, keep
             ) VALUES (
                0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::INT4, $1, $2, $2, $3, $4, $5,
                7200, 36000, 0, 0, 100, 0, 1
             ) RETURNING id
